name: scenario_0686
description: Jack is resting at home while managing some mild illness symptoms. He is using his time to review health information and plan some future financial education activities for his children.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Please check these two infographics for home remedies. Filter them to only include the ones that explicitly mention fighting 'congestion' or 'colds and flu'. Then check my Todoist 'Health' project and add any of those matching remedies as new tasks if they aren't already on the list.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to extract home remedies from the provided infographics, filter them for any that mention 'congestion' or 'colds and flu', and add the matching ones to your 'Health' Todoist project only if they aren't already listed there. If the assistant asks for clarification on the filter criteria, refer it back to the specific text in the images. Once the assistant confirms it has checked the existing tasks and added the missing remedy, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: I also want to make sure I stay hydrated based on the first infographic. Please set a phone reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM to start the specific fluid intake method mentioned in the middle bullet point.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to set a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM to start the fluid intake method listed as the second bullet point in the first image. If the assistant asks for the exact name of the method, instruct it to read the bullet points under 'Increase Fluid Intake' in the first image. Once the reminder is successfully scheduled, move on to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: While I'm resting, I'm planning activities for my 12-year-old based on this new parenting guide. Find the budgeting lesson for their age group. Check my Todoist Parenting project for an existing task named 'Buy piggy banks', and update its description to specify the three distinct types of piggy banks recommended here.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to find the budgeting lesson for your 12-year-old's age group in the new guide, locate the 'Buy piggy banks' task in your Parenting Todoist project, and update its description with the three specific types of piggy banks shown. The assistant will likely find multiple 'Parenting' projects on your device and ask which one you mean; clarify that you mean the one for Kathryn. If the assistant struggles to find the types of piggy banks, direct it to the 'How to budget finances' section for the 11-16 years age group. Once the task is successfully updated, conclude the conversation.
